verification.validation: Stale-socket recovery for ipc.ServeUnix/StartUnix and the executor-tier ipc.StartPeerUnix, and appbackup skipping unreadable or vanished SQLite files. Go tests for ipc (non-root, Linux container) and appbackup, go build ./... and go vet for both packages, sdk-version and executor manifest checks, npm pack of both packages and an internal-content scan of the packed tarballs. No frontend change, browser check, full gate, target matrix, executor rebuild, Rust build, crate publication or NAS acceptance.

changes: appbackup skips a detected SQLite database it cannot read, or one that vanishes during the export, with a per-file warning, and keeps exporting the healthy files (from #207).

ipc.ServeUnix/StartUnix replace a stale socket owned by this account that refuses connections, after an unchanged inode/device check; live, foreign and non-socket paths are refused and kept (from #208).
ipc.StartPeerUnix (executor-tier builds) recovers a stale socket the same way while keeping its root-owned 0660 contract (from #209).
Reuse executor 0.53.6 unchanged: executor sources and build inputs are unchanged and it does not import ipc.
